data.headline: Scratch filesystem degraded performance
data.formattedbody: We are investigating elevated latency on the /scratch filesystem. Jobs performing heavy I/O may run slower than usual. No data loss is expected.

updates.formattedbody: A failed metadata server has been taken out of rotation. Performance is recovering.

data.headline: Scheduled maintenance: cluster unavailable
data.formattedbody: The cluster will be offline for quarterly maintenance. Running jobs will be terminated; queued jobs remain queued and start after the outage.

data.headline: New H100 nodes available in the ai partition
data.formattedbody: Six additional nodes with 8x NVIDIA H100 accelerators have joined the ai partition. Request them with --gres=gpu:h100:1.

data.headline: Open OnDemand upgraded to 3.1
data.formattedbody: The portal has been upgraded. Interactive sessions started before the upgrade are unaffected.

data.headline: Researchers model protein folding at scale
data.formattedbody: A campus group used 1.2 million core-hours on the cluster to model folding pathways, with results published this month.

data.headline: Login node reboot completed
data.formattedbody: Rolling reboots to apply kernel security updates have finished. All login nodes are back in service.
